turns.query: Hong Kong's register classifies each air quality station as roadside or general. Over 2020 through 2025, how much more nitrogen dioxide does a roadside location carry than a general one?
Now ask the same of the total added health risk each station-hour carries — the sum of its four per-pollutant added-risk terms.

Over the same complete station-hours, do roadside and general stations have different median published AQHI bands? Explain what that comparison establishes about the concentration and health-risk differences you found.
